# LinkedIn Certification Checker

> Name the certificate and send the profile URL. The row says whether that profile has it. A no is still a completed check.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 profiles. You are charged once whether the answer is yes or no, because the profile was checked.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-certification-checker
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-certification-checker`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You have a required certificate and a list of profile URLs.

## Use something else when

You want every certification, patent, and course. Use LinkedIn Certifications and Patents.

## Page

- Check a LinkedIn profile for one certificate: docs/check-linkedin-certification.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
